END-TO-END 100% MIT STREAM MONITORING, 97%-COMPACT RAG, DOCS DEEP RESEARCH & DB-GPT PIPELINE (L1 ➔ L4)
1. Continuous Stream Ingestion & Alerts (quivr ★39.6k): Ingest live M365 emails, RSS & PDFs in Go; fire alerts when topics match rules.
2. 97%-Compact Vector Indexing (LEANN ★13.8k): Store massive private corpora with 97% storage savings (MLSys 2026 Best Paper).
3. Grounded Docs Deep Research (DocsGPT ★18.3k): Build citation-grounded doc assistants with Agent Builder & Deep Research workflows.
4. Controlled Data Warehouse Agents (DB-GPT ★20.3k): Generate verifiable SQL queries, analytical reports & reusable executive dashboards.
CLOSED-FORM FINOPS TCO MODEL (45-PERSON KNOWLEDGE, STREAM MONITORING & DATA AGENT TEAM · SYNTHETIC WORKLOAD MODEL)
• Path A (Bloated Vector DB Clusters + Commercial Stream Alert SaaS + Proprietary Data Agent Seats): $4,830.00/mo + 45.5h ($4,550.00) = $9,380.00/mo
